system.description:
Creates a one-way dimensional gate to another defined plane of existence or dimension.

  • Level 1: Create a one-way Portal to 1 defined dimension
  • Level 2: Create a one-way Portal to 2 defined dimensions
  • Level 3: Create a one-way Portal to 3 defined dimensions
  • Level 4: Create a one-way Portal to 4 defined dimensions
  • Level 5: Create a one-way Portal to 5 defined dimensions
  • Level 6: Create a one-way Portal to 6 defined dimensions
